svg.title: The FX-JEPA model: log-mel input with 8 channels for the dry and processed stems, 64 hand-measured features through FiLM, a small conv first layer and ViT-Tiny with 12 blocks. 44 named slots, one per stem and effect, write the switches and knobs. During training only, the audio and the true settings predict each other's embeddings.
